recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一個原始淋巴球：比紅血球稍大、核質比高、胞質只剩一圈淡藍色邊、染色質細緻均勻且核輪廓略不規則，無顆粒；外觀屬 L1 型原始淋巴球，T 細胞系需靠流式確認。
features: Single blast about 1.5 times red cell diameter
Very high N:C ratio with a thin rim of pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Round to slightly irregular nucleus with subtle indentation
Background normochromic red cells without other abnormalities
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single small-to-medium blast with a very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, a thin rim of agranular pale blue cytoplasm, finely stippled chromatin and a slightly irregular nuclear contour with inconspicuous nucleoli. No Auer rods are seen. The surrounding red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with a circulating lymphoblast; T-lymphoblastic leukemia requires confirmation by flow cytometry showing TdT and cytoplasmic CD3 expression.

ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; B-lineage blasts express CD19, CD79a and CD10 and lack cytoplasmic CD3.
Mature lymphocytes have coarse, block-like clumped chromatin and are TdT negative.
Myeloblasts usually have more cytoplasm, prominent nucleoli and may contain granules or Auer rods, with MPO positivity.
